environment: Linux Chromium, real IndexedDB and BroadcastChannel; mock account, no real Auth/HTTP or Apple verification

checks.name: selection requires synced originals and applies only to writing, not import drafts
outbox survives later edits and reload; ack advances only captured revision
draft edits and pending metadata commit atomically; quota rollback preserves old text
explicit remote install never overwrites existing draft and requires source floor
normal conflict preserves loser as unlinked ordinary draft with exact base references
multi-tab local edit invalidates stale resolution; valid local choice keeps remote text as new draft
applied marker is atomic with saved originals and waits for their sync
remote applied conflict forks text without reviving same ID or modifying originals
local applied conflict keeps terminal marker and forks remote text for later deliberate save
applied source requires exact version pair and matching text, even at satisfied floor
failed recovery write rolls back chosen draft, head and metadata together
pause and missing head reject late writes; selected drafts cannot be silently deleted
fixed account prevents cross-account draft state, snapshots and list access
two tabs serialize competing remote payloads at one server revision
failed terminal metadata write rolls back original, stage and operation receipt
malformed local metadata and draft kind replacement fail closed without text loss
no console/page errors or external requests
